summary: Retired math teacher urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for students in remote and isolated communities.

claims.argument: E-Rate program provides essential support for schools and libraries, ensuring broadband access for students and educational opportunities
claims.evidence_quote: For nearly 30 years, E-Rate has ensured that all students are eligible to equally access programs regardless of geographical, socioeconomic or cultural background. This is both your obligation and responsibility.
